summary: Verified all 3 new NewChatDialog enhancements + AddMemberDialog/GroupInfo sticky footers + regression on group creation. Backend 3/3 pass; frontend 6/6 pass. No overflow issues at 700px viewport.
critical_code_review_comments: NewChatDialog.jsx now 368 lines — still under 700, but the file is nearing complexity limit as more features (search + invite + folder-create + policy + models + avatar) accumulate in one component. Consider splitting the members subsection (search box + list + invite row) into a MemberPickerWithInvite subcomponent in a future refactor.

In NewChatDialog.inviteByEmail, the toast message uses 'Invite sent to ...' for a brand-new email but the backend already returns email_sent: true regardless — copy is accurate. However, if MAILGUN is not configured the backend still returns email_sent: true (from send_invite_email spawned via asyncio.create_task without awaiting result). Minor: UI cannot detect email delivery failure. Not a blocker.

Toast overlays (Sonner) sit above dialog action bars and briefly intercept clicks — this was observed only in automated tests where a fresh 'Chat created' toast overlaps the group-info-add-footer for a few seconds. Real users would rarely hit this because the info panel isn't opened immediately post-create. No fix required.
seed_data_creation: 2 QA groups + 1 invited throwaway email qa+<ts>@example.com created in sam's workspace (kept under the 2-invite budget requested).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 138 features verified end-to-end at 1280x700: (1) NewChatDialog fixed-header/scroll-body/sticky-footer — Cancel + Create pinned at ~y=648px; (2) member search filters by name/email (typed 'pri' → 1 of 3 rows; typed 'zzznobodyzzz' → new-chat-members-empty visible; clearing restores full list); (3) invite-in-create as owner: POST /workspace/invite succeeds, invited user auto-appears in list AND selected count increments (0 → 1), and group creation completes navigating into the new chat; (4) invite row hidden for member-role user raj@demo.team while member search still works; (5) AddMemberDialog sticky footer add-member-done-footer pinned at ~y=646, body scrolls independently, Done closes dialog; (6) GroupInfo sticky footer group-info-add-footer pinned at ~y=688, opens AddMemberDialog. Note: opening AddMember via group-info-add-footer immediately after creating the group can be intercepted by the 'Chat created' Sonner toast — used JS .click() to bypass in automation; real users won't hit this.
